definition.name: Actual Java sources, SDK ownership and enforced node

steps.name: Retain the exact checked-out source revision
steps.run:
git archive --format=tar.gz -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-feasibility-source.tar.gz" HEAD \
  apps crates sdk/java-guest sdk/rust tools wit/platform schemas examples \
  docs/component-development .cargo Cargo.toml Cargo.lock rust-toolchain.toml LICENSE NOTICE \
  .github/workflows/java-guest-feasibility.yml

steps.name: Test evidence and process-capture behavior
steps.run:
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
python3 -m unittest discover -s sdk/java-guest/tests -v

steps.name: Install pinned compiler tools
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
curl --fail --location --retry 3 --max-time 180 \
  https://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-9.1.0-bin.zip \
  -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/gradle.zip"
echo "a17ddd85a26b6a7f5ddb71ff8b05fc5104c0202c6e64782429790c933686c806  $RUNNER_TEMP/gradle.zip" | sha256sum --check
unzip -q "$RUNNER_TEMP/gradle.zip" -d "$RUNNER_TEMP"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/gradle-9.1.0/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
curl --fail --location --max-time 180 \
  https://github.com/WebAssembly/wasi-sdk/releases/download/wasi-sdk-29/wasi-sdk-29.0-x86_64-linux.tar.gz \
  -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz"
echo "87d1d1a2879d139cdc624b968efad3d4a97b8078cdff95e63ac88ecafd1a0171  $RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/wasi-sdk.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP"
python3 tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-bindgen"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-bindgen" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Qualify proposed transaction shapes and shared imported owners with the maintained Java compiler
Compile the authored transaction aggregate and forbidden immediate HTTP variant
Compile real Java sources and retain the first incompatible stage
Minimize supported Java WIT composition with the actual parser and C ABI
Execute Java code, exceptions and GC without claiming node admission
steps.run:
set -o pipefail
cargo --config .cargo/managed-guest.toml run --locked -p latent-wasmtime --features java-guest-diagnostic --example java_runtime_probe -- "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-guest-feasibility/probe.wasm" 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-guest-feasibility/runtime-probe.log"

steps.name: Compile generated typed Java bindings against async capability WIT
Execute typed Java values and async host suspension
steps.run:
set -o pipefail
cargo --config .cargo/managed-guest.toml run --locked -p latent-wasmtime --features java-guest-diagnostic --example java_runtime_probe -- "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-guest-bindings/compiled/component.wasm" --typed 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/java-guest-bindings/runtime-probe.log"

steps.name: Qualify standalone Java projects, nine SDK components, signed node and printed guide
Qualify separately signed typed Java domain through ordinary Java HTTP adapter
Retain diagnostics, generated source and component candidates
